gloss: to accomplish, to do, to make

definitions.explanation: To successfully complete or bring about something.
To make up or compose something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{偉業|いぎょう}→偉業：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{為|な}した。
{為|な}すべき⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{為|な}す。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{為|な}された⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This island was formed by a volcano.

examples.japanese: {為|な}す⟦{術|すべ}→術：noentry⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧しかなかった。
examples.english: I could only watch helplessly without being able to do anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{為|な}す。
examples.english: Each individual effort produces great results.

notes:
{為|な}す is a literary/formal verb meaning 'to accomplish' or 'to do.' In modern speech, ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is much more common.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{為|な}す

REGISTER: Literary/Formal
This verb is primarily used in formal writing, set expressions, and proverbs. It's rarely used in everyday conversation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {為|な}すべき⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧ (what should be done)
- {為|な}す⟦{術|すべ}→術：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no way to do anything)
- ⟦{志|こころざし}→志：06655_kokorozashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{為|な}す (to accomplish one's aspiration)
- 「{為|な}せば⟦{成|な}る→成る：01970_naru⟧」(Where there's a will, there's a way)

NOTE: Often written in hiragana as なす or in set expressions.
